scope.purpose: Conditional category evaluation of archived assertion coverage and author-prompt simplification; no new method ontology, production changes or model calls.

inspection.read: Complete extraction fields, including all State properties/components, Operation descriptions/mechanisms/information effects/roles/effects, Flows, scope, corrections, unknowns and archived reviewer rationales. Repeated evidence was deduplicated for reading; repeated PD-seq review text was grouped while retaining exact target coverage.
inspection.limit: Embedded quotations, image locators and historical acceptance report what earlier workers recorded. They are not independent confirmation of the original papers or image legibility. No new whole-paper scientific-validity verdict is made.
inspection.ui_limit: No live UI inspection. Facts recorded in State properties must not be scored as absent merely because a compact view shows only the label; actual display defects remain untested.
inspection.finding_policy: Source-reading narration is a readability/field-ownership issue, not automatically false science. Scientific qualifications and source-level caveats that affect interpretation must survive editing.
inspection.missing_assessment_limit: No consequential missing assertion was established in this annotation audit; this is not proof of completeness against independently reopened papers.

requirements.when: An encoded display or other surrogate is used for binding selection.
requirements.require: Distinguish displayed peptide/protein, encoding molecule, actual bait and capture support; state the supported encoding-to-display relationship and any consequential frame or mapping restriction.

requirements.when: Selected sequence counts or enrichments are interpreted as candidate interactors.
requirements.require: Identify what is sequenced/counted, selection-pool attribution and any control/comparison required for the stated conclusion. Preserve supported representation, growth/display/amplification and nonunique-mapping limits.

requirements.when: Baits, controls, rounds or libraries are independently processed.
requirements.require: Keep their identities and input-to-output correspondence recoverable; compact equivalent processing is acceptable without implying physical pooling.

do_not_require: A protein bait merely because of the inherited category: scoped PD-seq uses apigenin.
A particular phage, display scaffold, control design or barcode in every method.
Physiological full-protein interaction or affinity/abundance interpretation from sequence counts alone.

requirements.when: Selection or labeling restricts which genomic positions/ends enter the readout.
requirements.require: Identify the sampled regions/end population and the timing of restriction cleavage, original-end labeling and later fragmentation relative to labeling.

requirements.when: Adapters/linkers/barcodes carry attribution or make a later reaction selective.
requirements.require: Record the tag carrier, local role and scope: sample identity, original-end recognition or amplification interface are different functions.

requirements.when: Reads are interpreted as genotypes or break locations.
requirements.require: Separate raw sequence from downstream assignment; preserve restriction-site coverage, end accessibility/resection or other supported limits that change meaning.

do_not_require: Both restriction-site sampling and direct break labeling in the same assay.
Every barcode to identify an original molecule.
Every sequenced fragment end to be an original biological break.

requirements.when: Native input, physical partition or captured RNA class determines representation.
requirements.require: Record the actual prepared cells/lysate, capture population and compartment/support at the relevant boundary.

requirements.when: RNA is copied or a tag carries cell/molecule/sample identity.
requirements.require: Distinguish hybridized RNA from copied cDNA, locate tags on their actual carrier, identify when the association is established, and preserve supported attribution limits.

requirements.when: Material is pooled, physically split or data are integrated.
requirements.require: Preserve the order and distinct material/data routes. State the carrier of same-cell correspondence without implying molecular linkage.

do_not_require: Droplets, UMIs or one universal cell-indexing strategy for all low-input assays.
Full-length recovery from a 3-prime counting method or complete RNA coverage from poly(A) capture.
Physical DNA/RNA joining when same-cell data integration uses well/library records.

archived_review_summary.interpretation: Historical decisions, not new source verification.

assertions.assertion: Apigenin is the small-molecule bait on PEGA; mRNA-derived T7 inserts encode displayed protein sequences conditional on frame. The supplied commercial library is a prepared screening input with schematic mRNA provenance.

Preclearing retains the suspension; independent A/C selection, phage propagation and in-frame human insert enrichment support candidate targets. This measures selected phage representation, with frame/mapping/propagation limits, rather than RNA abundance or validated native-cell interactions.

Separate PCR/index preparations retain seven sampled fractions. Library indexes identify selection sample/round; insert sequence identifies the displayed candidate. Third-round selection is not silently treated as the sequenced first/second-round fractions.
Exact Input1/Input2 sampling origin relative to preclearing and A/C branches is intentionally unassigned in a nonblocking Unknown; no unsupported transfer repairs that gap.

findings.finding: Seven nearly identical PCR/index pairs repeat source-caption and granularity narration. Their distinct sample histories matter, but equivalent processing does not inherently require fourteen operation instances.
findings.candidate_improvement: Use compact equivalent processing only if all retained fraction identities, sample-index assignments and input-output correspondence remain recoverable. Preserve genuinely different A/C selection and the unresolved Input1/Input2 lineage.

findings.finding: activate.information_effect only says the support is prepared for bait immobilization; this restates a physical purpose rather than a distinct information claim.
findings.candidate_improvement: Keep support activation in description/mechanism; information_effect may be null if no separate supported attribution/preservation/loss is being stated.

archived_review_summary.interpretation: Historical decisions, not new source verification.

assertions.assertion: Reference-derived C-terminal heptapeptides are encoded by synthetic DNA and displayed as M13 P8 fusions. They are a designed proteome representation, with incomplete/mutated representation and potentially nonunique peptide-to-protein mapping.

Independently supplied recombinant PDZ bait is immobilized on support; displayed peptides bind it. The Hybridize correction is implemented as binding. Human/viral libraries and bait selections are not asserted to be pooled.

Selected phage DNA encodings yield peptide identities and counts attributed by selected-pool dataset identity to a bait, without an invented bait barcode. Counts are semiquantitative candidate-binding profiles with growth/display/PCR and physiological-context limits.

Plate format has diagram support while main-text confirmation of exact immobilization and selected-phage DNA/library preparation is absent. Two nonblocking Unknowns preserve this bounded evidence gap; a composite readout avoids inventing adapters or a specific preparation.

findings.finding: identify, make_oligos, immobilize, select and isolate_sequence mix procedure with discussion of drawings, primary-text coverage or block construction. The unknown library interface and binding correction are scientifically meaningful and must remain available.
findings.candidate_improvement: Move extraction-process narration to Evidence.rationale/Correction; retain direct binding, encoding, selection qualifications and the nonblocking evidence gaps.

archived_review_summary.interpretation: Historical decisions, not new source verification.

assertions.assertion: One chosen restriction enzyme defines the genomic subset. RAD uses random shearing after P1 ligation; the shared card second-digest alternative is assigned to ddRADseq, not forced into RAD.

P1 covalently attaches a sample barcode plus primer sites to restriction ends. Optional combining occurs after barcoding. P1-bearing and P1-lacking sheared molecules remain one preparation; attribution is confined to the bearing component.
Divergent P2 requires P1-initiated extension to create the productive reverse-primer interface. Selective PCR enriches P1-bearing tags while preserving the sample barcode.
Barcode-bearing restriction-adjacent reads support subsequent genotyping; they are not genotype calls. Enzyme-limited coverage and cut-site-dependent tag recovery are explicit.
The terminal caption remains visually unverified due to clipping, while sequencing is supported in embedded catalogue/primary text. This is a source-quality gap, not an absent extraction endpoint.

findings.finding: o4_p2.description explains why end preparation is inside a block; o5_amplify.information_effect explains omitted diagram colors. These are provenance/granularity notes alongside valid chemistry and sample-attribution claims.
findings.candidate_improvement: Keep end polishing/adenine/P2 and barcode-preserving selection in the explanation; move diagram-compression commentary to evidence.

archived_review_summary.interpretation: Historical decisions, not new source verification.

assertions.assertion: Accessible processed ends are proximal-linker labeled in purified fixed nuclei before extraction/fragmentation. Barcode junction and biotin have distinct positional and capture functions; resection/telomeres qualify original-break interpretation.

HaeIII fragmentation implements the correction. Labeled/unlabeled fragments coexist until streptavidin selection, and distal linker labels the later fragment extremity rather than a second independently established biological break.

I-SceI releases DNA for PCR; later XhoI trimming precedes the Illumina library. Amplified copies retain sequence-junction information without an assertion of intact original hairpins/biotin. Raw reads carry proximal/distal barcodes; localization needs barcode recognition and alignment.

Fine image structures are not visually verified and later catalogue background/fixation criticisms lack their primary context. Both gaps are preserved as nonblocking Unknowns, not promoted to focal-paper findings.

findings.finding: o_sequence.information_effect opens with the assay establishing genomic positions, while its actual output is sequence_reads. State content and attribution correctly condition localization on barcode recognition and alignment, so this is local imprecision rather than an established whole-record error.
findings.candidate_improvement: State the local output as barcode-adjacent genomic sequence and make alignment dependence explicit in this field. Preserve accessibility, telomere and resection qualifications.

findings.finding: The explanations repeat which steps are drawn versus text-supported and which correction supersedes random shearing.
findings.candidate_improvement: Retain HaeIII, ligation/release chemistry and measured-end limitations in the explanation; keep diagram comparison in Correction/Evidence.

archived_review_summary.interpretation: Historical decisions, not new source verification.

assertions.assertion: Prepared cell and bead/lysis streams form droplets. Productive co-encapsulation is conditional; poly(A) RNA hybridizes to bead oligo-dT before droplets break. Recovered beads, not intact compartments, enter bulk RT.

Cell barcode and UMI begin on DNA capture primers; cell barcode is shared within a bead while UMI varies. RT extends primers into cDNA carrying both identifiers, and read pairing links them to transcript-derived sequence.

The endpoint is a 3-prime cDNA-derived readout, with poly(A) selection, incomplete capture, doublet and ambient-RNA limits. RNA endpoint wording and replacement of the universal handle are corrected in the graph; template switching adds a downstream handle.

findings.finding: capture.information_effect says the compartment-specific mRNA-to-bead association is "to be made covalent" during RT. Read alone, that can imply covalent RNA attachment; adjacent properties and prepare_library correctly specify copied cDNA as the covalent reporter.
findings.candidate_improvement: Say that capture preserves a noncovalent RNA-primer association, and RT later creates barcode-bearing cDNA by primer extension. Do not add a state solely to fix this wording.

findings.finding: sequence.information_effect mixes a valid read-pair association with a justification for omitting a data-processing node.
findings.candidate_improvement: Keep the read-pair carrier and downstream alignment/UMI-counting dependency; move the node-construction rationale into evidence.

archived_review_summary.interpretation: Historical decisions, not new source verification.

assertions.assertion: RNA and gDNA share one cell lysate and one captured-lysate mixture before magnetic separation. The resulting bead-bound poly(A) mRNA and gDNA-containing liquid are genuinely distinct fractions.

Smart-seq2 yields mRNA-derived cDNA; MDA separately yields genomic DNA. Their libraries, reads and alignments remain distinct. Poly(A)-negative RNA is excluded, source RNA strand specificity is lost and WGA limitations remain explicit.

Corresponding wells and library identities carry same-cell pairing through separated routes into data integration. Transcriptome library indexes identify a per-cell library; the paired result is neither a DNA-RNA molecular join nor a causal conclusion.

The selected schematic uses MDA, with Smart-seq2 embedded. Genomic library preparation stays broad because the diagram does not select one chemistry; a primary recommendation is not converted into an obligatory route. Full-length cDNA representation is distinguished from whole-transcript short reads.

findings.finding: Sequencing and alignment descriptions repeatedly justify separate instances under a shared caption. The independent genomic/cDNA routes and final joint data integration are already explicit and scientifically consequential.
findings.candidate_improvement: Move shared-caption interpretation into evidence. Compact equivalent readout instances only if molecular origin, separate datasets and cell correspondence stay explicit; do not collapse MDA and Smart-seq2 into a common transformation.

prompt_consolidation.candidate: Consolidate repeated material/reporter/interface guidance into the short contract FIELD MEANINGS plus subject-specific structured assertions. Keep actual preparation, reporter origin, carrier and applicable next-interface facts; do not repeat the same six-part checklist in several sections.
prompt_consolidation.retain: Schema field definitions, exact references, empty State.features, self identity/data_type, and consequential omission review.

prompt_consolidation.candidate: Keep one diagram-block-first construction rule with supported text additions and a branch/interface exception. Equivalent repeated PCR/index operations may use compact collections if condition identity and correspondence remain explicit.
prompt_consolidation.retain: Genuine fractionation, distinct chemistry and data integration. Node count alone is neither a quality target nor a failure.

prompt_consolidation.candidate: Move statements about what a caption depicts, why a block was retained, or what the extractor read to Evidence.rationale/Correction. Explain procedure and mechanism directly.
prompt_consolidation.retain: Qualifications such as inferred protein identity, count confounders, source-dependent applicability and unknown preparation details. A mention of the paper is not itself an error.

prompt_consolidation.candidate: Retain one concise local rule: name the supported distinction and its carrier, including preservation/loss and interpretation dependencies. Use null for a field that merely restates a preparation purpose.
prompt_consolidation.retain: PD-seq insert versus index, RAD sample attribution, BLESS proximal-end history, Drop-seq cDNA barcode linkage and G&T well-based pairing.

prompt_consolidation.candidate: Keep method-specific counterexamples and these category requirements in evaluation unless a demonstrated regression motivates a minimal shared-rule repair. Do not add a mandatory phage/RAD/droplet/UMI recipe to the common author prompt.
prompt_consolidation.retain: Primary evidence confirmation at actual assertion level, independent image review, member/version scope and targeted evidence gaps.

independent_review_criteria: Reopen the same registered primary passages and diagram regions independently for factual review; compare actual assertions, not merely embedded quotations, accepted status, source names or JSON validity.

Trace a representative input through selection, reporter construction and readout, checking State properties, roles, effects and Flows together. Confirm the actual carrier and biological interpretation at each changed interface.

Check tag function separately from its name: insert identity, sample index, cell barcode, UMI and end-recognition barcode are not interchangeable. Do not require any one tag type absent source support.

When compact processing replaces repeated nodes, recover every retained unit/condition and input-output correspondence. Preserve genuinely different A/C selections or genomic/cDNA branches; do not infer mixing from a shared caption.

For corrections, confirm the operative graph implements the resolved bait, chemistry, order or endpoint. Preserve unresolved PD-seq Input1/Input2 lineage and ProP-PD preparation gaps unless newly inspected registered evidence resolves them.

Classify omitted supported consequential assertions as revision; unavailable consequential evidence as research; recorded-but-undisplayed facts as presentation; routine out-of-scope details as no added assertion. Evaluate source narration separately from scientific qualifications.

Check local information effects without requiring new signals: captured RNA is not covalently converted into barcoded RNA by RT; BLESS raw reads require barcode recognition/alignment before positional interpretation. Use adjacent assertions to distinguish a field-clarity issue from an incorrect whole workflow.

Compare archived and experimental outputs on the same category checklist and source bundle. Record holds/corrections and output readability, rather than treating brevity, node count or reviewer acceptance as scientific accuracy. One run per method is not a statistical superiority test.

artifact_validation.validation_scope: JSON syntax and exact references only; no new scientific validation.
